text: DSH Search & Proxy 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的搜索插件：它把 SearXNG 注册为网页搜索与抓取服务，并在插件设置页提供服务状态、搜索测试和路由控制。用户可连接现有 SearXNG，也可准备由插件管理的本地搜索服务；搜索支持设置引擎和结果语言，并可选择性配置实例认证。插件还提供可选的 DSH 进程代理，以及需用户明确开启的官方搜索或 Fetch 回退。适合希望使用自托管元搜索、配置搜索路由或管理 DSH 网络代理的用户。基础 SearXNG 搜索不要求 API key，需要配置可用的 SearXNG 服务地址。

DSH Search & Proxy 为 DSH Web 客户端注册 SearXNG 搜索与抓取服务，并在设置页显示服务状态、测试搜索和配置路由。用户可连接现有实例或准备插件管理的本地服务，设置搜索引擎、结果语言及可选认证。它还提供可选的 DSH 进程代理，以及需明确启用的官方搜索和 Fetch 回退，适合需要自托管网页搜索或管理 DSH 网络路由的用户。基础搜索无需 API key，但需配置可访问的 SearXNG 地址。

DSH Search & Proxy「SearXNG 网页搜索」：将 DSH 搜索请求发往配置的 SearXNG JSON 接口，并把结果整理为包含链接、标题和摘要的来源。
DSH Search & Proxy「托管搜索服务」：插件可准备或连接 SearXNG 服务；设置页显示服务状态，并支持发起搜索测试。
DSH Search & Proxy「搜索引擎与语言设置」：可配置 SearXNG 搜索引擎列表和偏好语言，选项用于后续搜索请求。
DSH Search & Proxy「可选官方搜索回退」：用户明确开启后，SearXNG 搜索失败时可使用官方搜索处理该次请求。

dsh-search-proxy README · DSH Search & Proxy：**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

Add **web search without a search API key by default** to [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), or connect DSH to a proxy you already use.

- **Want free search?** Search through SearXNG, without installing Docker or Python yourself.
- **Prefer official search?** Keep it and use the optional proxy to help with connectivity and downloads.
dsh-search-proxy README · DSH Search & Proxy：**Tested with:** DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`. See [compatibility and test coverage](docs/host-compatibility.md) for other versions and platforms.

dsh-search-proxy README · Install and start：> Upgrading from `dsh-web-search-searxng`? Follow the [migration guide](docs/rename.md) first so your saved settings keep working.

**1. Install the plugin.** Open **Plugins → Add plugin** in DSH, paste this address, then enable the plugin. No Git required.

```text
https://github.com/Chaos-Paradox/dsh-search-proxy/releases/download/v0.5.0/dsh-search-proxy-0.5.0.tgz
```

dsh-search-proxy README · Install and start：**2. Start searching.** Open **Plugins → DSH Search & Proxy** and click **Prepare and start**. Once the service shows **Ready**, choose your engines and language, save, and click **Test search**.

First use downloads the runtime; later starts reuse the cache. A prepared service starts and stops with the DSH backend. You can also connect an existing SearXNG instance. [CLI installation and more options](docs/reference.md#install-options).

dsh-search-proxy README · Just want the proxy?：Leave the plugin enabled and keep official search selected in DSH. **You do not need to prepare local SearXNG.** At the bottom of the plugin page, enter your existing proxy's host and HTTP / Mixed port, read the risk notice, and confirm to enable it.

The proxy is off by default. It may improve connectivity and download speed, depending on your network and proxy, and may affect other DSH network requests. [See the proxy panel](docs/proxy-0.5.0.en.jpg) · [Setup and risks](docs/proxy-risk.md).

dsh-search-proxy README · Costs and further reading：The SearXNG path has no per-search API fee. Model calls and official services retain their own pricing; the plugin's paid fallback is off by default.
